edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with owner() inside the onlyOwner modifier require.
Deployer msg.sender is passed to _setOwner via _msgSender() in the Ownable constructor.
releasedBalance branches and computes vesting directly from block.timestamp.
terminate sets _releaseEndTime from block.timestamp and derives _totalBenefit from it.
Constructor requires _releaseEndTime > block.timestamp.
_releaseStartTime is read to compute elapsed days.
_releaseEndTime is read to compute total days and full-release condition.
_totalBenefit is scaled by passedDays/totalDays.
unreleasedBalance subtracts releasedBalance from _totalBenefit.
_withdrawedBalance is read and updated in withdraw.
_totalBenefit indirectly bounds the withdrawable amount via releasedBalance.
_beneficiary is the recipient of the withdraw transfer.
_token is the ERC20 contract called by token() in withdraw.
releasedBalance() result determines the withdraw amount.
terminate assigns releasedBalance() to _totalBenefit.
_withdrawedBalance is used to compute the unreleased sweep amount.
onlyOwner gates who may call terminate.
isNotTerminated modifier reverts repeated terminate calls.
withdraw invokes an external ERC20 transfer to the beneficiary, a reentrancy hook.
terminate invokes an external ERC20 transfer to the owner, a reentrancy hook.
_totalBenefit feeds the multiplication/division in releasedBalance.
_withdrawedBalance feeds the subtraction computing the withdraw amount.
_withdrawedBalance feeds the subtraction computing amountToWithdraw in terminate.
isNotTerminated checks the _isTerminated state flag.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
token_ parameter is assigned to _token in the constructor.
beneficiary_ parameter is assigned to _beneficiary in the constructor.
releaseStartTime_ parameter is normalized and stored in _releaseStartTime.
daysOfTimelock_ parameter scales the release window length.
totalBenefit_ parameter is assigned to _totalBenefit.
newOwner parameter is validated and passed to _setOwner.
passedDays local feeds the releasedBalance multiplication/division.
totalDays local is the divisor in releasedBalance.
amount local is the value forwarded to safeTransfer in withdraw.
amountToWithdraw local is the value forwarded to safeTransfer in terminate.
oldOwner local is read from _owner inside _setOwner.
